customInstructions.project: job-agent: A Python-based job application assistant for resume generation, job discovery, and application tracking.
customInstructions.architecture: Python package with modules: ats, board_finder, cli, discovery, gap_analysis, inventory, jobspy_adapter, latex, models, parsing, scraping, tailoring, tracker
sessionRules: Summarize completed work after major milestones to save tokens
Batch file operations - read multiple files in one call when possible
Use execute_command over read_file when output is sufficient
Use qmd MCP for semantic search before reading files
Summarize context when approaching token limits
rules: Always verify Python syntax before saving files
Use type hints for all function parameters and return types
Keep functions under 50 lines when possible
Run tests after making code changes: pytest tests/
Use proper error handling with try/except blocks
Never commit secrets or API keys
workflows: For new features: write tests first, then implementation
For bug fixes: reproduce with test, then fix
For refactoring: ensure tests pass before and after
